modules.module_title: Analyze the script- Worldskills — Core Assessment Criteria

pcs.pc_description: analyse the script and making a careful analysis of the plot, tone, and period of the story being told
Break down scripts scene by scene to work out how many characters are involved and what costumes are required.
Check with the director or production manager on the exact number of characters needing costumes, as any non-speaking characters the director plans to include may not have been listed in the script.
Develop costume plots for each character
Costume colours and styles do not mimic each other in the same scene, unless required.
Costumes designed highlight the characters' emotional journeys by varying the intensity and depth of colours
Create the look of each character by designing clothes and accessories the actors will wear in performance
Individual props and wardrobes created / designed reflect the story being told and portray the character's personalities, cultures, ages, status and relationships.
Design costumes such way they depict characters Social position, economic status, occupation, gender, age, sense of style, tendencies towards conformity or individualism, etc.
Relationship of characters to each other.
Carry out research into the costume styles, designs and construction methods suitable for the time period depicted in the script or era of the story and the production concept
Using resources such as libraries, museums and the Internet to design the style.
Design costume such a way that they sets mood and establishes setting of the plot.
Ability and desire to research and continually learn about scenarios, cultures and periods of history which help demonstrate the director's vision

modules.module_title: Planning and budgeting- Worldskills — Core Assessment Criteria

pcs.pc_description: Prepare production budget accounting for all cost components of costumes department (include costume and props, Travel and stay, Logistics, Equipment, Food and snacks)
Allocating a separate budget for look and feel enhancing/ correction based on critical evaluation
Prepare and pitch the budget proposal to producer and director, deploying persuasive skill and justifications to finalise and arrive at a final number for the overall production budget.
make costumes depending on the style and complexity, and bought, revamped out of existing stock or rented stock.
identify budget, cost points and timing constraints
use fabrics, materials, suppliers and production processes are determined as required
prepare overall production schedules, as well as directing the day-to-day breakdowns of responsibilities.
supervise fabric research and purchase, and ensure that garments are completed to deadlines.
choose and hire appropriate suppliers and Costume Makers, negotiating terms with them, and communicating design requirements.
elaborate both the design and the making processes.
create and scale budgets depending on the numbers of costumes to be decide to create a dedicated Costume Workshop
interpret cost involved in making an apparel
controlling practical issues, such as departmental budgets and schedules
Prepare a docket highlighting the key choices made for production

modules.module_title: Costume design and development- Worldskills — Core Assessment Criteria

pcs.pc_description: Interpret the script and conceptualise ways to represent the character creatively through costumes and accessories that particular character wears.
conduct research and continually learn about scenarios, cultures and periods of history which help demonstrate the director's vision.
conduct research on target materials, designs, processes and marketing materials according to the needs of the character costume design

break down and identify the creative and technical requirements for different creative aspects in a manner that helps in realizing the overall creative vision (eg: Use- storyboard, shooting script, critical sequences and shot breakdown)
ensure that individual props and wardrobes reflect the story being told and portray the character's personalities, cultures, ages, status and relationships
ensure costume requirements with the Director and visual development team
use sketches, drawings and samples to illustrate design requirements, as appropriate
design and develop many costumes as they may be required for each character as costumes define the attitude and feel which may change with every new scene, setting or development
use the shapes, colors and textures during costume design which make an immediate and powerful visual statement to the audience in accordance to the script
identify Quality standards for designs
include any accessories such as canes, hats, gloves, shoes, jewelry or masks, etc
add a great deal of visual interest to the overall costume design by using these costume props.
use accessories to be objects of beauty in their own right
use costume props as items that truly distinguish one character from another, distinguish between major and minor characters, primary and secondary characters
create a costume plot which follows characters through the progression of the production, changing their attire when appropriate

modules.module_title: Mentor and monitor the costume Team- Worldskills — Core Assessment Criteria

pcs.pc_description: Select design development personnel and brief scope of work
Develop design as communicated with the team members
Construct the prototype and given to concerned department for better
Communicate the creative vision, project outcomes, functional roles, responsibilities, expectations, requirements, budget and timelines to functional heads prior to the production
Monitor periodic updates and ensure that any major changes agreed upon are recorded and communicated to the appropriate people
Develop a function-wise action plan to help execute the vision, as appropriate
Ensure that the teams are aware of their role towards realizing the creative vision of the project.
Articulate and encourage the need for team work and work standards that are expected to match the production’s requirements
Oversee the construction and running of any servicing rooms needed, e.g., work rooms, dyeing rooms, Costume Workshop etc.
Coordinate with tailors and other costume makers who turn the costume design sketches into real garments or wardrobes.
Ensure that a continuity book is maintained, including notes on character plots, photographs of individual costumes and instructions on how they should be worn.
Oversee the work of Assistants, Dailies and Standbys, and schedule their responsibilities for each particular day.
Drawing up and managing the departmental budgets and schedules
Facilitate dress rehearsals and be on set whenever a new costume is worn for the first time, to make sure that performers are comfortable, to explain special features, and to oversee any alterations

modules.module_title: Understanding the health, safety and security risks prevalent in the workplace

pcs.pc_description: understand and comply with the organizations current health, safety and security policies and procedures
understand the safe working practices pertaining to own occupation
understand the government norms and policies relating to health and safety including emergency procedures for illness, accidents, fires or others which may involve evacuation of the premises
participate in organization health and safety knowledge sessions and drills

modules.module_title: Knowing the people responsible for health and safety and the resources available

pcs.pc_description: identify the people responsible for health and safety in the workplace, including those to contact in case of an emergency
identify security signals e.g. fire alarms and places such as staircases, fire warden stations, first aid and medical rooms
identify aspects of your workplace that could cause potential risk to own and others health and safety
ensure own personal health and safety, and that of others in the workplace though precautionary measures
identify and recommend opportunities for improving health, safety, and security to the designated person
report any hazards outside the individuals authority to the relevant person in line with organizational procedures and warn other people who may be affected

modules.module_title: Complying with procedures in the event of an emergency

pcs.pc_description: follow organizations emergency procedures for accidents, fires or any other natural calamity in case of a hazard
identify and correct risks like illness, accidents, fires or any other natural calamity safely and within the limits of individuals authority
